findings.title: Every load re-reads the traces' 'Not tied' against the world's first-load cut, so a case restored from another world loses its red herrings at the next load
findings.where: scripts/gm-stores.mjs:2208-2227 settleTieStates (run at every GM's load by registerCaseHealth, :3004-3008); scripts/gm-store.mjs:530-548 fileSection (a file's stamps kept unless ahead of now); scripts/gm-stores.mjs:2431-2460 restoreCase (otherWorld: 'a moved server, a duplicated world')
findings.what_happens: The first load of a world as primary writes caseMark.tiesSettledBefore = that load's store stamp. Every later load moves to undecided each remnant row whose tiedToCrime is false and whose field stamp is under that cut. A restore keeps a file's field stamps (only a stamp ahead of now is clamped), and caseMark is a world setting the case file does not carry. A case file of another world restored into a world that has loaded once since 1.2.71 therefore brings 'Not tied' rows stamped before the cut, and the next load of any GM makes each of them undecided, with no word to anyone (the moved count is returned to a .then that discards it).
findings.evidence: gm-stores.mjs:2210-2219: `const cut = mark.tiesSettledAt ? mark.tiesSettledBefore : isPrimaryGm() ? before : null; ... if (row?.tiedToCrime === false && remnantStore.stampOf(key, "tiedToCrime") < cut) undecided[key] = { tiedToCrime: null };` and :2226 `if (!mark.tiesSettledAt) await markCase({ tiesSettledAt: gmStoreStamp(), tiesSettledBefore: cut });`; gm-store.mjs:534-538 `const bound = now + skew ... if (!(s > bound)) return s;` (an older stamp is kept); :3007 `markUpgrade().then(() => markCaseSince()).then(() => settleTieStates());`
findings.failure_scenario: A GM moves a campaign to a new world (scenes imported with their ids), opens it once, restores the old world's case file with 'Restore it here anyway', and reloads: every trace the GM had marked Not tied reads undecided on the dashboard, and the next victim's death ties those red herrings to the crime (remnants.mjs:2338 tieChapterTraces) and tells the identified copies.
findings.expected: A 'Not tied' restored from a file keeps its state: the one-time reading of pre-1.2.71 ties applies to rows written before 1.2.71, not to rows merged in after the world's first settle.
findings.refutation_tried: Looked for a re-stamp on restore (mergeIn, gm-store.mjs:968-976, and mergeInto, :306-327, keep the file's stamps; fileSection changes only stamps ahead of now + skew); for the case mark inside the backup (caseMark is SETTINGS.caseMark, a world setting, settings.mjs:340-352, not a GM store, so caseSections does not carry it); for a guard on rows merged after the settle (none: the walk reads every row of remnantStore, only the suite's `keys` narrows it). A same-world restore is safe: decisions made since the cut carry later stamps. A copied world folder carries its caseMark and is safe too. Not tried: whether a table really moves a case this way (adventure import keeping scene and token ids) - the restore's own window offers it (lang/en.json:7287 'This file is the case of another world ... Restore it here anyway.').
